scenarios.title: New Arabic onboarding screen
scenarios.prompt: Build a three-step Arabic onboarding flow in Flutter for a finance app. Use Cairo, a progress indicator, skip, next, and a final account-creation CTA.

criteria.text: RTL layout and semantic leading/trailing.
Cairo with readable line heights.
Realistic product-specific copy or clearly marked placeholders.
One primary action.
44/48 minimum targets.
Safe areas and text scaling.
No generic gradients, glass cards, or decorative blobs by default.
Correct mixed-direction treatment for numbers or currency.
Loading/error state for final submission.

scenarios.title: Audit an AI-looking home screen
scenarios.prompt: Review this React Native home screen. It has eight white cards, a purple gradient header, pill buttons, and strong shadows. Make it feel like a real productivity app.

criteria.text: Reports whether information hierarchy needs reorganization before restyling.
Identifies unnecessary cards, gradients, shadows, and radius variety with evidence.
Recommends a clearer primary action, sections, and reuse of existing tokens/components.
Does not invent fake productivity metrics.
Reviews accessibility and states without editing files.

scenarios.title: iOS settings detail screen
scenarios.prompt: Implement a SwiftUI notification-settings screen with account-level and category-level toggles.

criteria.text: Native navigation and controls.
System text styles/Dynamic Type.
44 pt targets.
Grouped content without unnecessary custom cards.
Clear dependency behavior between parent and child toggles.
VoiceOver labels and state.
No custom Liquid Glass content cards.
Safe handling of save/error state if persistence is asynchronous.

scenarios.title: Android checkout form
scenarios.prompt: Build a Jetpack Compose checkout address screen with country, phone, postal code, and continue button.

criteria.text: Material 3 components and theme.
`dp`/`sp`, 48 dp targets, IME actions, autofill, correct keyboard types.
Persistent labels and recoverable inline validation.
Locale-aware field behavior.
Insets and keyboard handling.
Loading and submission error state.
No disabled CTA with no explanation.
TalkBack semantics.

scenarios.title: Cross-platform design system refactor
scenarios.prompt: Clean up a React Native app where every screen uses slightly different spacing, button heights, and corner radii.

criteria.text: Inspects and inventories existing values.
Creates semantic tokens and component variants.
Normalizes buttons to named sizes.
Preserves platform navigation and feedback.
Minimizes unrelated visual change.
Migrates incrementally rather than rewriting everything.
Runs lint/types/tests and reports material limitations.

scenarios.title: Arabic data-heavy dashboard
scenarios.prompt: Design an Arabic mobile operations dashboard with KPIs, alerts, a timeline, and a small chart.

criteria.text: Maintains useful information density.
Does not turn every metric into a decorative card.
Uses Arabic RTL while evaluating chart direction by domain.
Locale-aware numbers, dates, and units.
Accessible chart summary and non-color status cues.
Responsive narrow-phone behavior.
Avoids fake data or labels it clearly.
